subject: ext-dy
title: EXT.DY.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-12. The following prose names the structural target: 'From early creative music (e.g., Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington) until the present, western journalism has basically focused on the form and tools of the music as a means to interpret whether or not a given participation corresponds to an imposed definition of "real" (or correct).' The crossing diagrams how extended-dynamics structurally meets social-reality dynamics at the journalism's-form-and-tools-focus scale: EXT-DY (extended dynamics — the form's actual extended-working) crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics — the partner-axis's working social-reality). EXT-DY sits centrally with the subject-arrow; SOC-RT-DY anchors the lower-left margin as partner-axis. EXPM (expansionism) branches up to the right from the main line and carries TRS (transition), which carries SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) and RE-ST (restructuralism); RE-ST carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which carries INFO-SOLD (information solidification), which carries (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation). C-INFO (composite information) branches down to the right and carries STF (source transfer). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) branches to the left and carries COS-P (cosmic-particulars).
